findings.location: the whole document, under its "Why the Pilot Result Applies Systemwide" heading

findings.violation: The argument never makes explicit the general principle that would have to hold for a 5-branch pilot's results to support a systemwide implementation. findings.fix: Qualify the scope and timing of the recommendation to match the evidence, or expand the grounds. findings.location: the whole document, under its "Recommendation" heading
findings.evidence: The recommendation specifies "eliminates overdue fines for all item types at all ten branches, effective at the start of the next fiscal year" based on grounds from a single 18-month pilot at 5 branches covering unspecified item types.
findings.violation: The specificity and scope of the recommendation (all items, all branches, next fiscal year) exceed what the grounds establish.
